issues.display_title: Issue #374: Wire real role/permission from the project payload into the capability model
issues.main_description_html:
Assignee: Ibnu Rizqia Ramadan — Developer

Part of #350 (sprint) — functional pack for #349 [PRD] Update Collaborators, Roles, and Permissions. Design pack merged in #373.

Description

The capability model (src/lib/collaboration/capabilities.ts, #357) is live but its only live role source is the realtime collab socket (useCollabStore.role). The REST project payload carries no role field (R1), so a collaborator whose socket has not joined resolves to Viewer until the socket connects. resolveRole() already implements the §B1 order (payload is_owner → known role string → viewer); the payload just never feeds it.

Blocked by BE: the Go API must add role, is_owner, and owner_email to the project list/get payloads. The FE seams are already typed optional (src/actions/projects.ts Project.is_owner?/owner_email?, ProjectAccess.role?), so this task is the wiring once those fields ship.

Scope

  • Feed role from the project payload into setProjectAccess at every load site (useWizardPersistence, PreviewTopbar, dashboard ProjectViews) — the TODO(backend) comments mark each spot
  • Dashboard ownership filter + Owner value read the real is_owner/owner_email (removes the "unknown counts as owned" fallback and the missing-owner-email gap in #353/#354)
  • Remove the closed TODO(backend) comments
  • Socket role stays as a fresher override when present (it can change mid-session)

Acceptance Criteria

  • A collaborator opening a project sees their real role on first paint, before any socket join
  • Dashboard "Shared with me" filter and Owner column show real values for projects owned by others
  • Viewer-by-default still holds when fields are absent (older payloads)
  • pnpm test, pnpm lint, tsc --noEmit green

RESULT

FE role wiring shipped; the closed dependencies were resolved not by adding role to the payload but by using the existing /access authority.

  • role (first paint): new getProjectAccess server action calls GET /v1/projects/:id/access on editor load; useEditorCapabilities falls back to that role while the socket role is still none, and only stays loading until a role is known. Socket stays the fresher override.
  • owner_email / is_owner: dashboard Owner column + "Shared with me" filter read the real payload fields; closed TODO(backend) markers removed.
  • Files: actions/members.ts, hooks/useWizardPersistence.ts, lib/collaboration/useProjectCapabilities.ts + capabilities.ts, components/dashboard/ProjectViews.tsx, lib/dashboard/projects.ts, actions/projects.ts.
  • FE PR #377 (commits 378bc0c, 50dbb51). BE owner_email on payload: GoThruMedia/Gothru-3d-Floormap-API-GO#114.
  • tsc/lint/vitest green.

issues.display_title: Issue #375: Collaborator invite: surface the server's email-send outcome

Assignee: Ibnu Rizqia Ramadan — Developer

Part of #350 (sprint) — functional pack for #349 [PRD] Update Collaborators, Roles, and Permissions. Design pack merged in #373.

Description

Item 6 of #350 (R8): inviting an existing user should send them an email. Sending is the Go backend's job and does not exist yet; the FE currently shows "<email> was added as a <role> and has been emailed." — asserting an email that was never sent.

Blocked by BE: invite/add-member response must say whether the email was sent (or expose a failure).

  • Map any new BE error/response codes into classifyInviteFailure / invite state machine (src/lib/collaboration/invite.ts)
  • Adjust copy in the sent/failure states; no layout changes

Acceptance Criteria

  • Success toast/message never claims an email was sent unless the BE confirms it
  • Email-send failure after a successful add is shown as a non-blocking warning (member is still added)
  • Invite state machine tests updated for the new outcomes
  • pnpm test, pnpm lint, tsc --noEmit green

  • Files: actions/members.ts (InviteResult), components/editor/collab/ManageCollaboratorsDialog.tsx, lib/collaboration/invite.ts, __tests__/invite.test.ts.

issues.display_title: Issue #388: Bug: selecting a door/wall after a room keeps the room selected (two selection toolbars stack)
issues.main_description_html:
Assignee: Ibnu Rizqia Ramadan — Developer

Editor selection bug.

Description

Select an area/room object, then click a different object type (e.g. a door/opening). The room selection is not cleared — both selection toolbars show at once: "1 selected" (opening: Size / Single·Double·None) and "1 room selected" (Height / Type). Should be single-category: picking a new type clears the previous selection.

Root cause

In src/lib/floorplanEditor/editor/selection.ts:

  • toggleOp (L11–15) only resets ctx.selWalls.
  • toggleWall (L17–21) only resets ctx.selOps.

Neither clears selRooms, selManual, selShapes, or selAnnos — unlike selectRoom (L75), selectAnnotation (L97), and selectShape (L110), which all reset every other-category bucket to keep the one-category invariant. So selecting an opening/wall after a room (or shape/annotation) leaves the prior selection live, and both toolbars render.

Scope

  • In toggleOp and toggleWall, also reset the cross-category buckets (selRooms = [], selManual = -1, selShapes = [], selAnnos = []), matching the select* helpers — so a new opening/wall selection is category-exclusive.
  • Keep intra-category multi-select (Shift+click multiple openings/walls) working.

Acceptance Criteria

  • Selecting a door/window/wall after a room (or shape/annotation) clears the previous selection — only one selection toolbar shows at a time.
  • Shift+click still multi-selects within the same category.
  • pnpm test, pnpm lint, tsc --noEmit green.

RESULT

Root cause confirmed and fixed in src/lib/floorplanEditor/editor/selection.ts.

toggleOp and toggleWall only reset their mutual bucket (walls ↔ openings); they now also clear selManual, selRooms, selAnnos, selShapes — matching the one-category invariant already enforced by selectRoom / selectShape / selectAnnotation. Selecting a door/window/wall after a room (or shape/annotation) now clears the prior selection, so only one selection toolbar shows. Intra-category Shift+multi-select is unchanged.

  • Files: src/lib/floorplanEditor/editor/selection.ts (toggleOp, toggleWall); tests added in __tests__/selection.test.ts (2 cases).
  • Branch: feature/388-selection-category-exclusive
  • Commit: 7a31765
  • vitest selection suite 11/11 green · tsc --noEmit · eslint green.

issues.display_title: Issue #384: Text style: Title Case for all menus, buttons, and section titles (English rules)
issues.main_description_html:
Assignee: Muhamad Rifky — Developer

MapThru FE text-style pass.

Description

Standardize UI label capitalization to Title Case following English title-case rules across the app: all menu items, buttons, and section/header titles.

Rule (English title case): capitalize the first & last word and all principal words (nouns, verbs, adjectives, adverbs, pronouns); keep short articles/conjunctions/prepositions lowercase (a, an, the, and, or, to, of, in, for, …) unless they are the first or last word. Keep proper nouns and product names as-is (MapThru, GoThru, GeoJSON, TXT, HTML).

Examples (from the Share modal)

  • "Share published project" → Share Published Project
  • "Share link" → Share Link
  • "Embed map" → Embed Map
  • "Embed to Virtual Tour" → already correct (to stays lowercase) ✅

Scope

Sweep user-facing labels for menus / buttons / section titles, e.g.:

  • Editor topbar + Project menu (src/components/editor/EditorTopbar.tsx): "Import editable TXT", "Export editable TXT", "Export GeoJSON", "Preview", "Collab", "Save", "Leave without saving", etc.
  • Share modal (src/components/preview/PreviewShareModal.tsx): section titles above.
  • Dashboard, wizard steps (src/components/setup/Step*.tsx), preview navbar, collaboration modals, dialogs.
  • Apply only to titles / buttons / menu labels — leave body/helper sentences in sentence case (e.g. "Anyone with this link can view the published project." stays as-is).

Acceptance Criteria

  • Menu items, buttons, and section/header titles across the app are Title Case per the rule above; prepositions/articles/conjunctions stay lowercase mid-title.
  • Proper nouns / product names / file formats unchanged.
  • Helper/description sentences remain sentence case.
  • pnpm lint, tsc --noEmit green; no functional changes.

issues.display_title: Issue #387: Bug: editor overlays (mode toggle, selection bar, toolbar) render on top of the New Information modal
issues.main_description_html:
Assignee: Muhamad Rifky — Developer

Editor modal z-index / stacking bug.

Description

When the New Information modal is open, several editor overlays paint on top of its backdrop instead of behind it:

  • the Editor / Map mode toggle (top-right),
  • the "1 selected · Clear selection" bar,
  • the bottom toolbar (select/move/eye/map/undo/redo).

Root cause

src/components/editor/InformationModal.tsx L71 renders a plain inline <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 …"> — no createPortal. Because it's mounted inside the editor DOM tree, its z-50 only competes within its local stacking context. The editor overlays are absolute z-20/z-30 and use translate/transform, which creates their own stacking contexts, so they escape and paint over the modal. This is the exact hazard already documented in add-panorama/ModalShell.tsx L112–113 ("a fixed z-50 child would be trapped inside it and render under the panels").

Scope

  • Portal InformationModal to document.body via createPortal so it escapes the editor stacking contexts, and give it a z above the editor overlays — reuse the convention in add-panorama/ModalShell.tsx (portal + z-[60]).
  • Check the sibling inline modals that share the same fixed inset-0 z-50 pattern (EditLevelModal, AddLevelModal, EditFileModal, preview/PanoModal, EditorTopbar leave-confirm) — same latent bug; fix consistently or extract a shared portaled shell.

Acceptance Criteria

  • With the New Information modal open, the mode toggle, selection bar, and toolbar are all behind the modal backdrop and not interactive.
  • Modal still centers, scrolls, and closes correctly.
  • pnpm lint, tsc --noEmit green.

issues.display_title: Issue #398: Bug: "Show markers" visibility toggle doesn't hide point/safety markers
issues.main_description_html:
Assignee: Ibnu Rizqia Ramadan — Developer

Editor object-visibility bug.

Description

Unchecking Show markers in the object-visibility menu still leaves point/safety markers drawn on the canvas. Every other toggle (doors, windows, shapes, connections, room labels) hides its layer; markers don't.

Root cause

The "Show markers" toggle sets ctx.showIcons via setShow(ctx, "icons", …) (model-sync.ts:225), default true (index.ts:54). But the point/safety marker render block in draw.ts:316–~340 is a bare { … } scope with no ctx.showIcons gate — so markers are drawn unconditionally, unlike the gated doors/windows/shapes/links blocks.

Scope

  • Gate the point + safety marker draw block on ctx.showIcons (wrap the block in if (ctx.showIcons) { … }) in draw.ts.
  • Verify setShow("icons", …) triggers a redraw (it does via rebuild), so toggling updates the canvas immediately.

Acceptance Criteria

  • Unchecking "Show markers" hides all point + safety markers; re-checking shows them.
  • Other visibility toggles unaffected; default (checked) still shows markers.
  • pnpm test, pnpm lint, tsc --noEmit green.

RESULT

Fixed in src/lib/floorplanEditor/editor/draw.ts: the point/safety marker draw block was a bare { … } scope with no visibility gate. Wrapped it in if (ctx.showIcons), matching the doors/windows/shapes/links layers. setShow("icons", …) already triggers a redraw via rebuild, so toggling updates the canvas immediately.

  • Branch: feature/398-show-markers-toggle · Commit: 07f573f
  • tsc · eslint green. (Canvas draw layer — no unit-test harness; one-line guard on an existing flag.)
